FAQ Frequently Asked Questions Have questions? Our FAQ section has you covered with quick answers to the most common inquiries. Effortlessly connect with your favorite tools. Whether it's your CRM, email marketing platform. 1. What is Obsero? Obsero is an AI search intelligence platform that helps brands understand and improve how they appear in AI-generated search results — including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. 2. Why should I care about AI visibility? AI tools are changing how people search, learn, and make decisions. If your brand isn't being surfaced (or is misrepresented), you're losing awareness, trust, and opportunity. 3. How does Obsero track my brand in ChatGPT or Google AI? We simulate real-world prompts, extract responses, and analyze visibility, sentiment, and positioning. You get actionable insights, not just raw data. 4. What's a "zero-click search"? That's when a user gets an answer directly in an AI-generated response — no need to click through. Obsero helps ensure your brand appears in that high-value answer zone. 5. Who is Obsero for? It's built for brand, SEO, marketing, and comms teams who want to stay visible, relevant, and competitive in the AI-first world. 6. Can Obsero help me outrank my competitors? Yes — our platform provides recommendations to boost your presence, identify competitor positioning, and craft strategies to win visibility battles.
